headline: Myanmar disputes 1 million Rohingya figure, rejects refugees’ origin claims
summary: The Myanmar government has challenged the widely cited number of Rohingya refugees and denied claims regarding their origin in the country.
details: Myanmar has officially disputed the figure of 1 million Rohingya refugees, questioning the data used to track the displaced population.
The Myanmar government has also rejected claims regarding the origin of the refugees, denying that they are indigenous to the region.
These disputes come amid ongoing international pressure on Myanmar to address the humanitarian crisis and facilitate the safe return of the refugees.
The Rohingya people have faced systemic persecution in Myanmar, leading to a massive exodus to neighboring Bangladesh.
International organizations continue to advocate for the rights of the Rohingya and the recognition of their citizenship in Myanmar.
